evidence_trace.narrative: PRIMARY SUSPECT: TRIDENT II (Crude Oil Tanker, MMSI 419001415) transiting Fujairah to Vadinar severed its AIS transmission for 4.8 hours across local nighttime while passing directly through the 90% drift origin cone at 2026-08-23T20:15 UTC. Vessel decelerated to 6.2 knots during blackout (characteristic bilge discharge profile). 4D reconstructed route achieves 89.1% spatial intersection, and forward confession advection matches the observed SAR slick with 74.2% IoU.
SECONDARY ATTENTION: PACIFIC VOYAGER (Chemical Tanker) transited south of the 90% origin envelope. Maintained continuous AIS broadcast at normal 12.4 kn cruise speed without loitering or speed drop.

CAUSAL VETO APPLIED: MV MAERSK KARACHI is currently 18 km from the detected slick at T=0, leading naive 2D distance filters to flag it. However, 4D backward hindcast establishes that 36 hours ago at spill release time, this ship was moored at JNPT Port (110 km east). Reconstructed route match is 0.0%. Fully exonerated as an innocent passer-by.
